_comment: AI City roster. Edit freely - the bridge reloads it on restart, and the tower rebuilds with however many floors this file (plus auto-discovered reporters) defines. `id` MUST match the cloud routine name exactly (underscores, not hyphens) or its floor will never light. Verified against the live RemoteTrigger list 2026-08-03. `at` is the ET shift time (HH:MM) used to order tower floors bottom-to-top and to light a floor during its shift window. `type`: daily | weekly | service. Weekly routines render as the penthouse boardroom. `retired` marks a routine that has been switched off - it KEEPS its floor, permanently dark, because the city is a record of what runs here, not only what is running today. Unknown agents that report events get appended here automatically with discovered:true - rename them, don't delete them, or they'll just come back.
_cloud: Five daily trading routines run as claude.ai cloud routines (RemoteTrigger), NOT local scheduled tasks: 07:00 overnight, 09:30 open, 10:00 trading, 12:00 trading, 15:15 close, plus the Saturday weekly review. Four dailies plus city_market_watch were RETIRED 2026-07-29 to cut usage. Cron expressions are in UTC; the `at` times below are the ET equivalents. They share the git repo github.com/AztecNightmare365/claude-trading-tasks and commit handoffs + trade_log.csv to it on every run. The 09:30 and 15:15 desks also write city-state.json, which is what makes hand-bought positions visible in the city.

agents.name: Overnight Desk
agents.role: Reads overnight positions from the 3:15 PM handoff, scans overnight news, fetches pre-market prices, writes the overnight brief. Since the 9:15 AM desk retired this is the only pre-open written analysis. Can place pre-market limit sells in catastrophic situations.

agents.name: Pre-Market Desk
agents.retiredWhy: Retired to cut usage. Its pre-open analysis is folded into the 7 AM Overnight Desk brief.
agents.role: Pre-market data via Polygon, flagged critical situations, wrote the pre-market brief. Placed no orders.

agents.name: Bell Desk
agents.role: Fires at the opening bell - enforces stops and take-profits against the open print, enters confirmed catalyst watch-list positions. Also writes city-state.json, the city's live account feed.

agents.name: Open Desk
agents.role: Main morning session: market regime gate, candidate sourcing via Polygon, order placement, handoff write. Its SKILL.md holds the handoff block the city parses.

agents.name: Midday Desk
agents.role: Midday reassessment and stop-trailing, may open new positions. Since the 1 PM and 2 PM monitors retired this is the last stop check before 3:15 PM, so its trailing levels have to stand unattended for three hours.

agents.name: Watch 1
agents.retiredWhy: Retired to cut usage. Stop coverage from noon to 3:15 PM is now the Midday Desk's trailing levels.
agents.role: Stop-loss / take-profit monitor. Sold only - never opened positions.

agents.name: Watch 2
agents.retiredWhy: Retired to cut usage. Stop coverage from noon to 3:15 PM is now the Midday Desk's trailing levels.
agents.role: Stop-loss / take-profit monitor. Sold only - never opened positions.

agents.name: Close Desk
agents.role: Last session of the day: overnight hold/exit evaluation, final order placement, handoff to tomorrow. Also writes city-state.json. Its handoff has to stand alone overnight now that the 5 PM desk is retired.

agents.name: After-Hours Desk
agents.retiredWhy: Retired to cut usage. The Close Desk handoff now has to carry overnight on its own.
agents.role: After-hours prices and earnings results, assessed AH exits, built the next day's catalyst watch list, placed AH limit sells.

agents.name: The Boardroom
agents.role: Saturday performance review - reads the trade log, computes per-dimension stats, writes LEARNED INSIGHTS back into the trading routines.

agents.name: Market Watch
agents.retiredWhy: Retired after running 65 sessions/week - the main cause of the usage blowout. Replaced by a zero-token parse: the bridge reads city-state.json (written free by the 9:30 AM and 3:15 PM desks) plus the 3:15 PM handoff block. The name is kept as the byline on portfolio events.
agents.role: Was the tower's data feed - a cloud routine that read the Robinhood account hourly and committed city-state.json.
